protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. Flint CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW parses the inner SQL with the non-greedy catch-all materializedViewQuery rule, is classified as a Flint extension/index query, and is dispatched to Spark without the ordinary SQL deny-list validation. Wrapping denied Spark SQL such as TRANSFORM ... USING therefore bypasses the validation boundary and can execute commands on Spark workers.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed 486063eb4afcc1c0fb4b6ecf81300eb88f976017 as the smallest public first-write: it adds the CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW grammar, opaque inner-query capture, visitor handling, and dispatch path that submits the original query to Spark.
